info.title: Tirelo Services API
info.description:
REST API for Tirelo Services — a Botswana on-demand local-services marketplace (provider discovery, bookings, payments, reviews, messaging, notifications, analytics and admin).

## Conventions
- All responses are JSON enveloped as `{ "success": true, "data": ... }`; errors are `{ "success": false, "error": { "message": ..., "details"?: ... } }`.
- Monetary amounts are integers in **minor units** (thebe; 100 thebe = 1 BWP).
- Authentication is a Bearer JWT in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
- Obtain tokens via `POST /api/auth/login` (or `/register`), refresh via `POST /api/auth/refresh`.
